scope: P01 onward, including future added pages
purpose: Separate high-saliency authored display art, variable native copy, shared publication furniture, photos and page-specific ornaments so V30 stays editorially rich without rasterizing everything or flattening the publication into generic Figma UI.
authorityPrinciple: Latest owner feedback wins. This manifest supersedes older page-specific rules that classified a visible element as NATIVE_TEXT merely because it contains text, when that element is actually a short locked high-saliency authored display object.

GENERATED_DISPLAY_ASSET.definition: Short locked high-saliency editorial display art whose lettering, vessel, outline, shadow and local accents materially behave as one authored object.
examples: locked name labels where lettering treatment is part of the page identity
rules: exact visible wording must be owner-approved/locked before generation
source text remains recorded in authority/metadata
generate the complete visual object when native reconstruction would look generic or materially weaker
QA spelling and art character at A5 size

NATIVE_TEXT.definition: Copy that benefits from continued editability or is long, variable, TBD, factual/personal, or likely to change.
NATIVE_TEXT.rule: Native text is not the default merely because an element contains text. Role and editorial saliency decide first.

SHARED_PUBLICATION_COMPONENT.definition: Cross-page recurring publication furniture with one master visual system and controlled variable content.
SHARED_PUBLICATION_COMPONENT.rule: Design once as a master component/system, then instantiate across pages. Do not independently redraw or regenerate one version per page.

PAGE_SPECIFIC_ORNAMENT.definition: Local decorative/editorial art whose composition belongs to one page position and narrative job.
PAGE_SPECIFIC_ORNAMENT.rule: May belong to a global ornament family, but final composition is page-specific unless repetition is intentionally designed.

PHOTO.definition: Replaceable real or clean standalone proxy photography.

decisionOrder: Does it repeat across pages with only controlled variable content? -> SHARED_PUBLICATION_COMPONENT
Is it page-specific decoration with no essential locked display copy? -> PAGE_SPECIFIC_ORNAMENT
Is it long/variable/TBD/personal/frequently changing copy? -> NATIVE_TEXT
Is it short, locked, high-saliency editorial lettering whose authored treatment materially defines the page? -> GENERATED_DISPLAY_ASSET

sharedPageBadgeSystem.designRule: PAGE 01, PAGE 02 and later page badges are one publication component, not separate page designs.

recommendedArchitecture.master: one authored/generated decorative badge shell derived from the V30/Rurubu visual language, installed as one Figma component
recommendedArchitecture.variable: page number is a component text/property variable; PAGE label may remain fixed within the component
recommendedArchitecture.instances: P01 onward use instances/variants of the same master
recommendedArchitecture.reason: This preserves exact cross-page design while avoiding eight independently generated PNGs and scales naturally to P09+.

sharedPageBadgeSystem.currentCalibration: P01 PAGE 01 is a useful visual reference but must be rebuilt/extracted into the shared system rather than copied as an isolated P01-only raster.
hardRejects: P01 raster badge beside a separately designed P02 ellipse badge
same semantic PAGE furniture drifting in stroke, typography, backing, icon or scale across pages

displayFamilyProduction.rule: Related display assets should be designed/calibrated as a small family or batch when they share one semantic system, then installed independently where composition requires.
examples: title plus subtitle/ribbon treatment when they form one header ecology

gates.DISPLAY_ROLE_CLASSIFICATION_PASS: All material visible elements are classified by editorial role rather than text-vs-image alone.
gates.DISPLAY_ART_QUALITY_PASS: Generated display assets have publication-grade authored lettering/vessels and do not look like generic Figma text effects.
gates.SHARED_PUBLICATION_COMPONENT_PASS: Shared furniture is implemented from one master and visually consistent across applicable pages.
gates.COPY_LOCK_PASS: Any generated visible wording is exact and owner-approved.
gates.TRUE_ALPHA_PREFLIGHT_PASS: Floating generated display art follows the current true-alpha generation policy.

futurePageRule: P09+ inherits the shared component masters automatically and classifies new high-saliency display art using the same decision order. Do not create a new visual system merely because a new page is added.
